feature: 换头／人物身份参考 · 修复重试
claim_level: 公众号索引标题；一般参考编辑探索，非专用换头模型
prompt: Replace only the complete head and hair of the woman in image 1 with the fictional adult woman from image 2: many freckles, green eyes, short curly copper hair. Keep the same three-quarter head turn looking LEFT. Remove every trace of black hair. Preserve the red scarf, navy coat, park scene and body. No yellow sweater, no extra neck or hair.
expected: B服装姿态背景保留，头部外观采用A。
retry_reason: 裁切参考排除黄毛衣，并扩大头发合成范围后完整4步及CPU解码。红卷发、雀斑、绿眼与左转头向出现，但黑色长发仍保留，颈部有重影且黄色仍混入领口。问题没有解决，保留独立失败视觉证据。
runtime_profile: Dynamic GPU encoding; Kroma Q2_K FP16 with upcast; isolated CPU decode
timing_scope: Sum of encoding, sampling, decoding submission-to-history times; excludes cold starts
acceptance_scope: 普通Kroma双图换头，非Krea BFS；黑发残留、领口污染及精确身份未通过
